name: Zenarmor (OPNsense) Detection Suite
summary: Decoder and severity-graded rules for Zenarmor NGFW events forwarded from OPNsense: one alert per block, unblocked threats found in every record type (connection tags, TLS and web categories, DNS domain categories), quiet DNS lookups raised by their pattern (beaconing, DGA), DNS resolvers recognised without a site list, names that betray a tool (out-of-band testing, mining pools, tunnelling services, Cobalt Strike stager), and normalised fields for other packs.
summary_zh: OPNsense 上 Zenarmor NGFW 事件的解碼器與分級規則：每次阻擋只告警一次，從每種記錄（連線標籤、TLS 與網頁分類、DNS 網域分類）找出未被阻擋的威脅，DNS 查詢靜默記錄、依行為模式（beacon、DGA）提出，不需站台清單即可認出 DNS 解析器，認出暴露工具身分的名稱（頻外測試、挖礦礦池、通道服務、Cobalt Strike stager），並提供可供其他套件使用的標準化欄位。
author: Jason Tools
notes: OPNsense must forward Zenarmor's reporting data to the Wazuh manager by syslog, with the program name zenarmor (zenarmorngfw also decodes), and the stream must include Alerts as well as Connections, DNS and TLS. The alert record is the one record per block that carries Zenarmor's decision and the name it matched. According to the vendor, streaming is not available in the Free and Home editions.

Grading: an unblocked malicious connection is the most serious case (130801 for a conn record, 130851 for a TLS or web session, level 12), because the session was established; an unblocked phishing site is level 10 (130803, 130852). A blocked connection is graded per event from its alert record: malware 130802 (level 7), command-and-control 130820 (level 10), phishing and fraud 130804 (level 5), potentially dangerous 130855 (level 4), dynamic DNS, newly registered and first-seen sites 130857 (level 3). Weak categories (Proxy, VPN, Parked Domains) stay at level 5 or below, and at level 3 when the policy blocked them (130828).

Where Zenarmor puts the category (measured, version 1.6): conn and alert records carry security_tags; TLS and web records carry a single category and no security_tags; a dns record carries security_tags only when the lookup was blocked, otherwise the category is in domain_categories (Zenarmor 1.17.4 removed the security category from DNS reports). The 1.5 rules for unblocked threats read security_tags only, so an unblocked phishing TLS session (measured twice in 7 days) and every unblocked threat lookup went unnoticed; 1.6 reads all three.

One block arrives as several records: a DNS block as a dns record, a conn record of the UDP flow and an alert record; a web block as conn, tls and alert. Each block is reported once, from its alert record; the others are recorded at level 2 (130815 for malware, 130829 for phishing, 130862 for evasion categories) or stay at level 0, and a lookup's dns record is also counted (below). Measured over 7 days: 1,854 alert records against 3,627 conn and dns records for the same blocks.

A lookup of a threat name never alerts by itself, blocked or not. Its alert record (when blocked) is recorded at level 2 (130816, 130817); its dns record, which carries the query type and the Recursion Desired bit, is classified and counted. Client-style lookups count towards beaconing, 15 lookups of one name in 15 minutes (130832, level 10), and towards 20 different threat names in 15 minutes, together with blocked connections (130833, level 10). A command-and-control name alerts at once: blocked 130819 (level 6), resolved for a client 130864 (level 8). This needs the DNS stream.

Unblocked threat lookups (1.6) are recorded at level 2 (130821 and its children) because, measured over 7 days on the full stream, all 1,315 of them came from two forwarding resolvers: RD=1 A and AAAA lookups sent to a public resolver look exactly like a client's, and 1,035 had no resolver evidence before them. A per-lookup alert would have been about 150 a day. Counted instead, the peak for one source in any 15 minutes was 7 lookups of one name and 7 different names, so 130832 and 130833 stay silent while a real beacon still trips them.

Internal DNS resolvers and mail filters look names up for other hosts, so the firewall sees them, not the client. They are recognised without a site list. A dns record with Recursion Desired = 0 (an iterative query, which a client never sends) or of type PTR, NS or SOA is resolver style on its own (130842, 130843, 130837, 130838, 130845, 130846). A client-style record (RD=1, A and the like) from a source that sent a resolver-style record within the last 15 minutes is a forwarded lookup (130844, 130847, 130848, 130850, 130865). Resolver lookups are counted only by 130834 (40 lookups of one name in 15 minutes, level 6) and 130835 (40 different names, level 7); the resolver's own query log names the client. Measured over 7.5 days on the tuned site: 1,584 of 1,811 blocked dns records were resolver style on their own; of the other 227 (a domain controller forwarding A lookups), 149 had evidence before them and 76 arrived in the same second as their evidence but just before it.

etc/lists/jt-zenarmor-resolvers is optional tuning. It is needed only for a forwarding DNS server that relays clients' A lookups and never sends an iterative or a PTR, NS or SOA query itself: from the firewall such a server looks exactly like a client using a public resolver. Its lookups then go to 130818, 130849 and 130823 and are counted like a recognised resolver's.

Correlation memory: analysisd keeps correlation history only for the last memory_size events that matched a rule of level 1 or more (memory_size in the global section of ossec.conf, default 8192). Older events are freed and no longer count for any frequency or if_matched rule, whatever its timeframe. At about 75 events a second that is 15 to 20 minutes, on a busier manager less. Every timeframe in this pack is therefore 900 seconds or less and the thresholds are per 15 minutes. A beacon slower than about one lookup a minute, or resolver evidence older than the memory reaches, is not seen; raising memory_size widens the window at the cost of manager memory.

Names that betray a tool alert whatever Zenarmor's category says, on unblocked dns, TLS and web records: out-of-band testing domains (interactsh, Burp Collaborator, canarytokens, dnslog and about 25 more suffixes, 130841, level 10; 130840 for the alert record of a block), crypto-mining pools (130866, 130874, level 10), tunnelling services and Tor web gateways (trycloudflare, ngrok, localtunnel, serveo, playit, tor2web, .onion: 130868, level 5) and Cobalt Strike's default DNS stager (130870, level 10). A lookup through a resolver counts too: some host behind it asked. Measured on the full stream over 7 days: no mining, tunnelling or stager name; one out-of-band burst (a mail gateway resolving one interactsh name 13 times in four minutes). The suffix lists re-implement ideas of SigmaHQ rules (cited in the rule file).

Other categories added in 1.6: Keyloggers and Monitoring and Compromised Websites are in the malware family (Compromised was an evasion tag before); DNS Tunneling (a premium category) alerts at level 10 from its alert record (130861); DNS over HTTPS tags are evasion; a malformed DNS packet is recorded (130859) and 20 from one host in 15 minutes alert at level 6 (130860, measured peak 5); an application-control block of a Remote Access or Proxy application is level 3 (130875). Dead Sites never alerts. The premium categories (Botnet C&C, DNS Tunneling, Newly Registered Sites and others) exist only with a subscription: on other editions those rules simply never fire.

Two Proxy-category sources are recorded at level 2 instead of alerting: Apple iCloud Private Relay (130825; 629 of 978 evasion alerts in 7 days) and check.torproject.org, the Tor exit list that threat-intelligence tools download every hour (130826; 349). A site that forbids Private Relay should block mask.icloud.com and mask-h2.icloud.com in DNS. Other site-specific names go in etc/lists/jt-zenarmor-domain-allow, which applies to the evasion categories and the tunnelling-service names only and never to malware or phishing. An allowed DNS over HTTPS session (measured 72 TLS records in 7 days) does not alert.

Sibling rules under one parent are tried in a fixed order on Wazuh 4.14.7: higher level first, the same level in load order (analysisd source, rules_list.c). The threat-tag families are mutually exclusive by pcre2 lookahead, in this precedence: malware, phishing, DNS tunnel, potentially dangerous, evasion, weak, malformed DNS, parked (version 1.4 had fixed one overlap: Botnet DGA Domains matched malware and phishing). The name rules use the order on purpose: they are tried before the level 2 lookup rules. negate is not used: every exclusion is a positive match.

The decoder adds srcip, srcport, dstip, dstport and protocol, and three fields that are the same for every record type: zenarmor.index (conn, dns, tls, http, sip, alert), zenarmor.domain (the matched name for alert records, the query for dns records, the destination name otherwise) and zenarmor.category (since 1.6 also for an unblocked dns record, from domain_categories). Other packs and CDB lists can use them. Note that srcip is always the internal client: a level-based active response configured on the manager would now see it, so exclude the zenarmor group from such a response.

Parked Domains is recorded at level 0 and never alerts. The classifier appears to key on the apex having no A record, which also describes any CDN-fronted application backend, so its false-positive rate is very high. Real DGA activity is covered by 130833 instead.

Not covered: the syslog stream carries reporting records only, so Zenarmor engine errors, cloud and licence messages, policy changes and TLS-inspection failures are not in it. Allowed use of remote-access tools, DNS over HTTPS and VPN or proxy applications is not alerted per record (measured: thousands of AnyDesk records a week from one host); a first-seen alert would need first-time-seen tracking, which Wazuh cannot attach to a decoder that hands its fields to the JSON decoder. Generic web-filtering blocks (Ads, Social and other non-security categories) reach rule 130800 at level 0 by design. The pack ships no active response: every source address here is an internal client, and Zenarmor already blocks what it can.

Verified on Wazuh 4.14.7: the <prematch>zenarmor</prematch> decoder from the vendor guide does not match; this pack uses <program_name>zenarmor</program_name>. Short tokens are anchored with \b (otherwise Tor matches Torrent).
notes_zh: OPNsense 必須把 Zenarmor 的報表資料以 syslog 轉送到 Wazuh 管理端，程式名稱為 zenarmor（zenarmorngfw 也能解碼），而且串流除了 Connections、DNS 與 TLS 之外必須包含 Alerts。每次阻擋只有 alert 記錄會帶 Zenarmor 的判定結果與比對到的名稱。依原廠文件，Free 與 Home 版沒有串流功能。

分級原則：未被阻擋的惡意連線最嚴重（conn 記錄為 130801，TLS 或網頁工作階段為 130851，level 12），因為連線已經成立；未被阻擋的釣魚網站為 level 10（130803、130852）。已阻擋的連線依 alert 記錄逐筆分級：惡意程式 130802（level 7）、C2 130820（level 10）、釣魚與詐騙 130804（level 5）、潛在危險 130855（level 4）、動態 DNS、新註冊與首次出現的網站 130857（level 3）。弱訊號分類（Proxy、VPN、Parked Domains）一律 level 5 以下，被政策阻擋時為 level 3（130828）。

Zenarmor 把分類放在哪裡（1.6 版實測）：conn 與 alert 記錄帶 security_tags；TLS 與網頁記錄只帶一個 category、沒有 security_tags；dns 記錄只有在查詢被阻擋時才帶 security_tags，否則分類在 domain_categories（Zenarmor 1.17.4 起 DNS 報表不再含資安分類）。1.5 的未阻擋威脅規則只讀 security_tags，所以未被阻擋的釣魚 TLS 工作階段（7 天實測 2 次）與所有未被阻擋的威脅查詢都沒被發現；1.6 三種都讀。

一次阻擋會產生好幾筆記錄：DNS 阻擋是 dns、UDP 流量的 conn 與 alert 各一筆；網頁阻擋是 conn、tls 與 alert。每次阻擋只依 alert 記錄回報一次，其餘記錄以 level 2 記下（惡意程式 130815、釣魚 130829、規避分類 130862）或停在 level 0，名稱查詢的 dns 記錄另外用來計數（見下）。7 天實測：同一批阻擋有 1,854 筆 alert 記錄，對上 3,627 筆 conn 與 dns 記錄。

威脅名稱的查詢本身不告警，不論是否被阻擋。它的 alert 記錄（被阻擋時）以 level 2 記下（130816、130817）；它的 dns 記錄帶有查詢類型與 Recursion Desired 位元，用來分類與計數。用戶端式的查詢計入 beacon：15 分鐘內同一名稱 15 次（130832，level 10），也與被阻擋的連線一起計入 15 分鐘內 20 個不同的威脅名稱（130833，level 10）。C2 名稱立即告警：被阻擋為 130819（level 6），替用戶端解析成功為 130864（level 8）。這需要 DNS 串流。

未被阻擋的威脅查詢（1.6）以 level 2 記錄（130821 及其子規則），因為在完整串流 7 天實測中，1,315 筆全部來自兩台轉送型解析器：送往公共解析器的 RD=1 A 與 AAAA 查詢看起來與用戶端完全一樣，其中 1,035 筆之前沒有解析器證據。逐筆告警約每天 150 則。改為計數後，單一來源在任何 15 分鐘內的峰值是同一名稱 7 次、不同名稱 7 個，所以 130832 與 130833 保持安靜，真正的 beacon 仍會觸發。

內部 DNS 解析器與郵件過濾器會替別的主機查詢名稱，防火牆看到的是它們而不是真正的用戶端。不需站台清單就能認出它們。Recursion Desired = 0 的 dns 記錄（迭代查詢，用戶端永遠不會送出）或類型為 PTR、NS、SOA 的記錄，本身就是解析器式（130842、130843、130837、130838、130845、130846）。來源在最近 15 分鐘內送過解析器式記錄時，它的用戶端式記錄（RD=1，A 等）視為轉送的查詢（130844、130847、130848、130850、130865）。解析器的查詢只計入 130834（15 分鐘內同一名稱 40 次，level 6）與 130835（40 個不同名稱，level 7）；真正的用戶端請查該解析器自己的查詢記錄。調校所用站台 7.5 天實測：1,811 筆被阻擋的 dns 記錄中有 1,584 筆本身就是解析器式；其餘 227 筆（一台網域控制站轉送的 A 查詢）有 149 筆之前已有證據，76 筆與證據在同一秒到達、只是排在證據之前。
etc/lists/jt-zenarmor-resolvers 是選用的調校。只有轉送型 DNS 伺服器才需要它：它轉送用戶端的 A 查詢、自己從不送出迭代查詢或 PTR、NS、SOA 查詢，從防火牆看起來與使用公共解析器的用戶端完全一樣。列入後其查詢改由 130818、130849 與 130823 記錄，並與被認出的解析器一樣計數。

關聯記憶：analysisd 只保留最近 memory_size 筆命中 level 1 以上規則的事件作為關聯歷史（ossec.conf global 區段的 memory_size，預設 8192）。更舊的事件會被釋放，不論規則的 timeframe 多長，都不再計入任何頻率或 if_matched 規則。每秒約 75 筆事件時大約是 15 到 20 分鐘，負載更高的管理端更短。因此本套件所有 timeframe 都是 900 秒以下，門檻以每 15 分鐘計。慢於約每分鐘一次的 beacon、或比記憶範圍更舊的解析器證據都看不到；調高 memory_size 可以加大範圍，代價是管理端記憶體。

暴露工具身分的名稱，不論 Zenarmor 的分類為何，只要出現在未被阻擋的 dns、TLS 與網頁記錄就告警：頻外測試網域（interactsh、Burp Collaborator、canarytokens、dnslog 等約 25 個尾碼以上，130841，level 10；被阻擋時由 alert 記錄的 130840 回報）、挖礦礦池（130866、130874，level 10）、通道服務與 Tor 網頁閘道（trycloudflare、ngrok、localtunnel、serveo、playit、tor2web、.onion：130868，level 5），以及 Cobalt Strike 預設的 DNS stager（130870，level 10）。經由解析器的查詢也算：它背後有主機查了這個名稱。完整串流 7 天實測：沒有任何礦池、通道或 stager 名稱；頻外測試只有一次（郵件閘道在四分鐘內對同一個 interactsh 名稱查了 13 次）。尾碼清單是依 SigmaHQ 規則的想法自行實作（規則檔內附來源）。

1.6 新增的分類：Keyloggers and Monitoring 與 Compromised Websites 歸入惡意程式家族（Compromised 原本是規避標籤）；DNS Tunneling（付費分類）依 alert 記錄以 level 10 告警（130861）；DNS over HTTPS 標籤歸入規避；格式錯誤的 DNS 封包以 130859 記錄，同一主機 15 分鐘內 20 次以 level 6 告警（130860，實測峰值 5）；應用程式控制阻擋 Remote Access 或 Proxy 類應用程式為 level 3（130875）。Dead Sites 永不告警。付費分類（Botnet C&C、DNS Tunneling、Newly Registered Sites 等）需要訂閱：其他版本上這些規則只是永遠不會觸發。

兩種 Proxy 分類來源改以 level 2 記錄、不告警：Apple iCloud 私密轉送（130825；7 天內 978 筆規避類告警中佔 629 筆），以及 check.torproject.org，也就是威脅情資工具每小時下載的 Tor 出口節點清單（130826；349 筆）。禁止私密轉送的站台應在 DNS 封鎖 mask.icloud.com 與 mask-h2.icloud.com。其他站台特有的名稱請加入 etc/lists/jt-zenarmor-domain-allow；此清單只作用於規避分類與通道服務名稱，永遠不會讓惡意程式或釣魚告警靜音。被允許的 DNS over HTTPS 工作階段（7 天實測 72 筆 TLS 記錄）不告警。

Wazuh 4.14.7 上同一父規則的子規則依固定順序嘗試：level 高的先，同 level 依載入順序（analysisd 原始碼 rules_list.c）。威脅標籤家族以 pcre2 lookahead 互斥，優先順序為：惡意程式、釣魚、DNS 通道、潛在危險、規避、弱訊號、格式錯誤的 DNS、寄放網域（1.4 版曾修正一個重疊：Botnet DGA Domains 同時符合惡意程式與釣魚）。名稱規則刻意利用這個順序：它們在 level 2 的查詢規則之前被嘗試。不使用 negate：所有排除都是正向比對。

解碼器新增 srcip、srcport、dstip、dstport、protocol，以及三個對所有記錄類型意義一致的欄位：zenarmor.index（conn、dns、tls、http、sip、alert）、zenarmor.domain（alert 記錄是比對到的名稱，dns 記錄是查詢名稱，其他是目的主機名稱）與 zenarmor.category（1.6 起未被阻擋的 dns 記錄也有，取自 domain_categories）。其他套件與 CDB 清單可以直接使用。注意 srcip 一律是內部用戶端：管理端若設定了依等級觸發的主動回應，現在會看到它，請把 zenarmor 群組排除在該回應之外。
Parked Domains 為 level 0、不告警。分類器似乎以 apex 沒有 A 記錄判定，而 CDN 前置的應用程式後端正好符合，誤判率極高。真正的 DGA 行為改由 130833 涵蓋。

未涵蓋：syslog 串流只有報表記錄，Zenarmor 引擎錯誤、雲端與授權訊息、政策變更與 TLS 檢查失敗都不在其中。被允許的遠端控制工具、DNS over HTTPS 與 VPN 或代理程式的使用不逐筆告警（實測一台主機每週數千筆 AnyDesk 記錄）；「首次出現」告警需要 first-time-seen 追蹤，而 Wazuh 無法把它掛在交給 JSON 解碼器處理欄位的解碼器上。一般網頁過濾的阻擋（Ads、Social 等非資安分類）依設計停在 130800（level 0）。本套件不附主動回應：這裡的來源位址全是內部用戶端，而 Zenarmor 已經擋下它能擋的。
Wazuh 4.14.7 實測：官方指南的 <prematch>zenarmor</prematch> 解碼器不會匹配，本套件改用 <program_name>zenarmor</program_name>。短詞一律加 \b 邊界（否則 Tor 會誤中 Torrent）。

setup.title: Install the pack and reload the ruleset on every node
setup.title_zh: 安裝套件並在所有節點重新載入規則集
setup.body: Install from this page, then use Reload Ruleset on the Rules tab. A cluster synchronises rule files but does not reload the workers. The rules must be on the node that receives the firewall's syslog. Installing declares the two CDB lists in ossec.conf; on a cluster, declare them on the workers as well.
setup.body_zh: 在本頁安裝後，到「規則」分頁按「重新載入規則集」。叢集只同步規則檔、不會重載 worker。規則必須存在於接收防火牆 syslog 的那個節點。安裝時會在 ossec.conf 宣告兩份 CDB 清單；叢集環境請在 worker 也宣告。

setup.title: Stream Zenarmor's reporting data to the manager by syslog
setup.title_zh: 把 Zenarmor 報表資料以 syslog 串流到管理端
setup.body: In OPNsense open Zenarmor, Configuration, Data Management (called Reporting & Data or Settings, Reporting & Data, Streaming Data in some versions), and enable streaming to a remote syslog server: the Wazuh manager's address, the port of its syslog listener, UDP or TCP. Streaming is not available in the Free and Home editions. Select Connections, DNS, TLS, Web and Alerts. Alerts is required: without it every blocked threat stays at level 2. DNS is required: the dns records are what lookups are counted and resolvers recognised from; without them no lookup pattern is detected. TLS and Web are required for unblocked threat sites (130851 to 130853) and for the tool names (130841, 130866, 130868). Records are about 2 KB, so over UDP they travel as IP fragments; a firewall in between must pass fragments, or use TCP. If a relay filters the stream, see the next step. Nothing on the firewall restarts.
setup.body_zh: 在 OPNsense 開啟 Zenarmor → Configuration → Data Management（部分版本稱 Reporting & Data，或 Settings → Reporting & Data → Streaming Data），啟用串流到遠端 syslog 伺服器：填入 Wazuh 管理端位址、其 syslog 監聽埠、UDP 或 TCP。Free 與 Home 版沒有串流功能。勾選 Connections、DNS、TLS、Web 與 Alerts。Alerts 為必要：沒有它，所有被阻擋的威脅都會停在 level 2。DNS 為必要：查詢是依 dns 記錄計數、解析器也是依它認出；沒有它，任何查詢模式都偵測不到。TLS 與 Web 是未被阻擋的威脅網站（130851 到 130853）與工具名稱（130841、130866、130868）所必需。每筆記錄約 2 KB，走 UDP 時會被切成 IP 分段；中間若有防火牆必須放行分段，否則請改用 TCP。若中間有轉送程式過濾串流，請見下一步。防火牆上不需要重啟任何服務。
setup.verify: Browse from a test client to a site your policy blocks as Phishing or Malware. Within a minute or two the manager shows 130804 or 130802 with the blocked name; the conn and tls records of the same block are recorded as 130815 or 130829 and do not alert.
setup.verify_zh: 從測試用戶端瀏覽一個政策會以 Phishing 或 Malware 阻擋的網站。一兩分鐘內管理端應出現 130804 或 130802，並帶有被阻擋的名稱；同一次阻擋的 conn 與 tls 記錄記為 130815 或 130829、不告警。

setup.title: If a relay filters the stream: what to keep
setup.title_zh: 若中間有轉送程式過濾串流：要保留哪些記錄
setup.body: The full stream is large: measured on one site over 7 days, 10.3 million records (conn 7.5 million, dns 1.7 million, http 0.58 million, tls 0.52 million, alert 15,000). Every record that no rule needs ends at level 0 and is cheap for the manager, but a relay (Vector, syslog-ng, Logstash) may drop some. Keep: every alert record; every record with is_blocked 1 or a non-empty security_tags; tls and http records whose category is a security category (Malware/Virus, Phishing, Potentially Dangerous and the like); dns records whose domain_categories holds one. For the tool names (out-of-band testing, mining pools, tunnelling services, the stager) keep all dns, tls and http records: those names carry no category. conn records with empty security_tags (73% of the volume here) are used by no rule. A filter that keeps only blocked and tagged records, as before 1.6, still works for every blocked threat but hides unblocked ones and the tool names.
setup.body_zh: 完整串流的量很大：某站台 7 天實測 1,030 萬筆（conn 750 萬、dns 170 萬、http 58 萬、tls 52 萬、alert 1.5 萬）。沒有規則用到的記錄都停在 level 0，對管理端負擔很小，但轉送程式（Vector、syslog-ng、Logstash）可能會過濾。請保留：所有 alert 記錄；所有 is_blocked 為 1 或 security_tags 非空的記錄；category 為資安分類（Malware/Virus、Phishing、Potentially Dangerous 等）的 tls 與 http 記錄；domain_categories 含資安分類的 dns 記錄。工具名稱（頻外測試、礦池、通道服務、stager）沒有分類，需要保留所有 dns、tls 與 http 記錄。security_tags 為空的 conn 記錄（此處佔 73% 的量）沒有任何規則使用。像 1.6 之前那樣只保留被阻擋與帶標籤的記錄仍可涵蓋所有被阻擋的威脅，但會看不到未被阻擋的威脅與工具名稱。
setup.verify: From a test client resolve a name Zenarmor categorises as Malware/Virus but your policy allows (or any name ending in oast.fun). The dns record reaches the manager as 130821 or one of its children (level 2), or 130841 (level 10).
setup.verify_zh: 從測試用戶端解析一個 Zenarmor 歸類為 Malware/Virus 但政策允許的名稱（或任何以 oast.fun 結尾的名稱）。該 dns 記錄應以 130821 或其子規則（level 2），或 130841（level 10）出現在管理端。

setup.title: Accept syslog from the firewall
setup.title_zh: 接受防火牆送來的 syslog
setup.body: The manager needs a remote block for syslog that allows the firewall's address (or the relay's). Changing ossec.conf needs a manager restart; agents reconnect by themselves.
setup.body_zh: 管理端需要一個允許防火牆（或轉送程式）位址的 syslog remote 區塊。修改 ossec.conf 需要重啟管理端；agent 會自動重新連線。

setup.title: Optional: list forwarding DNS servers
setup.title_zh: 選用：列出轉送型 DNS 伺服器
setup.body: Recursive resolvers and mail filters are recognised automatically from their own DNS records. A forwarder that relays clients' A lookups and never sends an iterative or a PTR, NS or SOA query itself cannot be told apart from a client; if one trips the beaconing or many-domains rules (130832, 130833) with lookups made for its clients, list its address, one per line, then reload the ruleset. A network prefix ending in a dot (192.0.2.) also works. Its own non-DNS connections are not affected.
setup.body_zh: 遞迴解析器與郵件過濾器會從它們自己的 DNS 記錄自動認出。轉送型伺服器若只轉送用戶端的 A 查詢、自己從不送出迭代查詢或 PTR、NS、SOA 查詢，就無法與用戶端區分；若它以替用戶端做的查詢觸發 beacon 或多網域規則（130832、130833），請把它的位址列入，每個一行，加入後重新載入規則集。也可以寫以點號結尾的網段前綴（192.0.2.）。它自己的非 DNS 連線不受影響。
setup.verify: The next blocked lookups from a listed address are recorded as 130818 or 130849 instead of 130836 or 130839.
setup.verify_zh: 列入的位址之後被阻擋的查詢會記為 130818 或 130849，而不是 130836 或 130839。

setup.title: Allowlist names that Zenarmor files under Proxy or VPN, and fixed tunnel names
setup.title_zh: 把 Zenarmor 歸類為 Proxy 或 VPN 的名稱，以及固定的通道名稱加入允許清單
setup.body: For a corporate VPN endpoint or a similar service in an evasion category, or a fixed tunnel name the site uses on purpose (myapp.ngrok.app): one name per line, exactly as it appears in the alert, then reload the ruleset. The list applies only to the evasion rules 130805 and 130806 and the tunnelling-service rule 130868; malware and phishing alerts are never silenced by it.
setup.body_zh: 適用於公司 VPN 端點這類被歸到規避分類的服務，或站台刻意使用的固定通道名稱（myapp.ngrok.app）：每個名稱一行，寫法與告警中完全相同，加入後重新載入規則集。此清單只作用於規避類規則 130805、130806 與通道服務規則 130868，永遠不會讓惡意程式或釣魚告警靜音。
